summary.short: Creates Brazil's National Transmission Access Policy (PNAST): from 8 December 2025, permanent access to the basic transmission grid and increases in contracted use go through periodic Access Seasons run by the ONS, with competitive processes where demand exceeds capacity. Sets transitional rules for pending requests; excludes distribution utilities.
summary.long: Decreto 12.772/2025 creates the PNAST for users seeking permanent access to the transmission system or more contracted transmission use; distribution concessionaires and permissionaires are excluded. Access to the basic grid and increases in contracted use occur through Access Seasons: periodic windows in which applicants register demand, analysed jointly by the national system operator (ONS). Where registered demand exceeds available capacity at a connection point, competitive processes are held; their revenues go to tariff moderation. Under ministry guidelines, these processes may cover future capacity, voluntary release of contracted amounts, capacity conditioned on investment, and margins for regional development. The first season must be held within ten months of publication and at least two a year from the following year, with schedules published 90 days ahead. Requests filed before publication receive access opinions within ten months, without priority for future margins or revalidation; interim requests need remaining capacity. Consumer requests pending at the ministry go to the ONS, subject to a 45-day financial guarantee, and the ministry plans grid expansions for them. EPE gains access to applicant data and runs an annual mapping call. Decreto 5.597/2005 is amended to cover multi-unit hubs or clusters at one connection point.

territorial_scope.description: Access to the transmission system and basic grid of Brazil's National Interconnected System (SIN); distribution concessionaires and permissionaires are excluded.

obligations.summary: Users seeking permanent access to the basic grid or an increase in contracted transmission use must go through Access Seasons, formally registering their access demand in periodic windows.
obligations.conditional_on: Opening of the first Access Season (Art. 7 §1); interim rules of Arts. 9-13 apply until then

evidence.quote: O acesso permanente à rede básica e o aumento do montante de uso contratado ocorrerão por meio de Temporadas de Acesso.

obligations.summary: After the Access Season stages, only users meeting the technical, economic and financial requirements proceed to the access procedure with the ONS under Aneel regulation.
obligations.conditional_on: Completion of an Access Season; requirements set by Aneel regulation

evidence.quote: os usuários que cumprirem os requisitos técnicos, econômicos e financeiros seguirão o rito de acesso junto ao ONS, conforme regulação da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica – Aneel

obligations.summary: The ONS develops, operationalises and runs the Access Seasons, analysing registered demands jointly and in coordination, and sets their periodicity and schedules.

evidence.quote: O ONS será responsável por desenvolver, operacionalizar e executar as Temporadas de Acesso

obligations.summary: Competitive processes are held within Access Seasons for connection points where registered demand exceeds available capacity.
obligations.conditional_on: Registered demand above available capacity at the connection point

evidence.quote: serão realizados processos competitivos dos pontos de conexão onde a demanda registrada superar a capacidade disponível

obligations.summary: Revenues from the competitive processes are applied to tariff moderation, under Ministry of Mines and Energy guidelines and Aneel regulation.

evidence.quote: As receitas obtidas nos processos competitivos das Temporadas de Acesso serão revertidas para a modicidade tarifária, conforme diretrizes do Ministério de Minas e Energia, com regulação estabelecida pela Aneel.

obligations.summary: Ministry of Mines and Energy guidelines may provide for competitive processes for future capacity, a voluntary stage to release contracted amounts, future capacity conditioned on winners' investments, and a specific margin for regional development policies.

evidence.quote: A partir de diretrizes do Ministério de Minas e Energia, os processos competitivos das Temporadas de Acesso poderão prever

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Mines and Energy may use Access Seasons to support decisions on tenders for basic-grid expansion, and their results to coordinate EPE planning studies and the Transmission Grant Plan.

evidence.quote: poderão ser utilizadas como ferramenta de apoio à tomada de decisão do Ministério de Minas e Energia para fins de licitação com vistas à ampliação da rede básica do SIN

obligations.summary: Energy and capacity auctions that use transmission margin as a selection stage may use the Access Seasons as a preliminary stage, under Ministry of Mines and Energy guidelines.

evidence.quote: poderão utilizar, como etapa preliminar, as Temporadas de Acesso de que trata este Decreto, conforme diretrizes estabelecidas pelo Ministério de Minas e Energia

evidence.quote: terá acesso aos dados e informações dos usuários que se inscreverem nas Temporadas de Acesso, para a avaliação e o uso das informações nos estudos de planejamento energético nacional

obligations.summary: EPE must hold an annual public call mapping generation potential, large consumers, industrial hubs, organised ports, industrial parks and clusters, infrastructure and other projects affecting electricity consumption or generation, for ten-year planning.

evidence.quote: deverá realizar anualmente chamada pública para mapeamento de potenciais de geração, de grandes consumidores, de polos industriais, de portos organizados, de parques e clusters industriais

evidence.quote: deverá interagir com o ONS para auxiliar no desenvolvimento dos estudos de acesso à rede básica, observado o critério de mínimo custo global

obligations.summary: Permanent basic-grid access requests filed after publication and before the first Access Season are accepted only if remaining capacity exists at the requested connection point and the request is filed before the season opens and earlier than the ONS regulatory analysis period.

evidence.quote: forem apresentadas antes da abertura da primeira Temporada de Acesso e com antecedência maior que o prazo regulamentar de análise exigido pelo ONS

obligations.summary: In computing remaining capacity for the first Access Season, the ONS deducts capacity already reserved by valid access opinions issued under Arts. 9 and 10.

obligations.summary: Consumer requests pending at the Ministry of Mines and Energy on the publication date are forwarded to the ONS for an access opinion under Art. 9, without prior ministerial authorisation.

evidence.quote: As solicitações de consumidores em curso no Ministério de Minas e Energia na data de publicação deste Decreto serão encaminhadas ao ONS para emissão de parecer de acesso nos termos do disposto no art. 9º, dispensada prévia autorização ministerial.

obligations.summary: The ONS analyses the forwarded consumer requests in chronological order of filing at the Ministry and may require complementary technical documentation to continue the analysis.

evidence.quote: O ONS analisará as solicitações de que trata o caput em ordem cronológica de protocolo no Ministério de Minas e Energia.

obligations.summary: Analysis of consumer requests forwarded from the Ministry (Art. 12) and of consumer access requests filed up to publication (Art. 13) requires a financial guarantee within 45 days of publication, under Aneel regulation.

evidence.quote: A análise somente será realizada se o interessado apresentar garantia financeira no prazo de quarenta e cinco dias contado da data de publicação deste Decreto, nos termos da regulação da Aneel.

obligations.summary: Exceptionally, the Ministry of Mines and Energy is to determine, through an extraordinary revision of the Transmission Grant Plan, basic-grid expansions primarily to serve consumer access requests filed up to publication, including those forwarded under Art. 12.

evidence.quote: Excepcionalmente, o Ministério de Minas e Energia determinará, por meio de revisão extraordinária do Plano de Outorgas de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica, expansões na rede básica que serão destinadas prioritariamente a atender

obligations.summary: Consumers with requests under Art. 13 may reduce the transmission amounts requested, adjusting the financial guarantee within 45 days of publication, keeping their original place in the analysis order.

obligations.summary: After the 45-day periods, the ONS computes new transmission margins for the Art. 13 requests, with the main guideline of maximising the transmission use contracted from the expansions.
obligations.conditional_on: Expiry of the 45-day periods of Art. 13 §§1-2

evidence.quote: o ONS calculará as novas margens de escoamento destinadas às solicitações de acesso de que trata este artigo, adotando como diretriz principal a maximização do montante de uso do sistema de transmissão a ser contratado

obligations.summary: The absence of specific regulation does not prevent the ONS from running Access Seasons, provided Ministry guidelines and the PNAST are respected.

evidence.quote: A ausência de regulação específica não impedirá a realização das Temporadas de Acesso pelo ONS

obligations.summary: Consumer access to the basic grid under Decreto 5.597/2005 must be preceded by the steps listed in its Art. 2 (items not restated here; item I repealed by Art. 16), including an ONS access opinion; this also applies to a project, hub or cluster with multiple consumption units at one connection point, under Aneel regulation.

definitions.term: Política Nacional de Acesso ao Sistema de Transmissão – PNAST [National Transmission Access Policy]

evidence.quote: Fica instituída a Política Nacional de Acesso ao Sistema de Transmissão – PNAST, destinada aos usuários que pretendam acessar o sistema de transmissão em caráter permanente ou aumentar o montante de uso do sistema de transmissão contratado.

As Temporadas de Acesso são janelas periódicas nas quais os interessados registram formalmente suas demandas de acesso, que serão analisadas de forma conjunta e coordenada pelo Operador Nacional do Sistema Elétrico – ONS.

enforcement.note: The decree sets no sanctions. The only consequences stated are procedural: requests are not analysed without the financial guarantee (Art. 12 §2, Art. 13 §1), interim requests are not accepted without remaining capacity (Art. 10), and access opinions under Arts. 9-10 cannot be revalidated.

notes: Data centres are not named in the text; the provisions relevant to large loads are the Access Season regime (Arts. 3, 7), the transitional treatment of consumer requests (Arts. 12-13), EPE's mapping of 'grandes consumidores' and industrial clusters (Art. 5 II), and the extension of Decreto 5.597/2005 Art. 2 to projects, hubs or clusters with multiple consumption units at one connection point (Art. 15). For that reason only 'energy_grid_water' is coded as a domain. Delegated and not in this text: Aneel regulation of the access procedure, requirements, guarantees and revenue use (Art. 3 §§4-5, Art. 12 §2); Ministry of Mines and Energy guidelines for seasons and competitive processes (Art. 3 §§5-7, Art. 6, Art. 14); season periodicity and schedules set by the ONS (Art. 7 caput). The ONS is coded as 'utility_grid_operator' and its duties as type 'other' (it is not a government body in the text's terms). Duties stated in the passive voice for the seasons (Art. 3 §3, Art. 7 §§1-2) are attributed to the ONS because Art. 3 §2 makes it responsible for running them. Event dates are computed from publication on 2025-12-08 (ten months: 2026-10-08; 45 days: 2026-01-22). The 230 kV threshold is coded from the restated Art. 3 I of Decreto 5.597/2005; the decree marks the whole item as new wording (NR) and does not show which words changed. Per the consolidated Decreto 5.597/2005 on planalto.gov.br (context only, outside the annotated text), the repealed Art. 2 I required a Ministry of Mines and Energy ordinance before access.
